failures.root_cause: sw-code-review-test.sh uses a sed command that references a file path as the script argument instead of an inline expression, causing 'No such file or directory' error
failures.fix: Fix the sed invocation in sw-code-review-test.sh to use -e flag for inline expressions: sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g" instead of treating the substitution as a file path
